purpose: Pinned public source references for the UR-Recomp Nintendo Switch homebrew feasibility lane.

components.role: Nintendo Switch AArch64 homebrew userland library
Canonical public usage examples, including SDL2 graphics examples
Public helper tools for Switch homebrew development

package_manager_dependencies: Switch portlibs as required, initially SDL2
policy: Pins are reproducibility/provenance references. Source revisions remain architectural references; Gate S0 cross-builds use the dated devkitPro container and retain installed package/compiler metadata. Do not vendor an arbitrary SDK installation into Git.

ci_toolchain.purpose: Pinned public cross-build environment for Gate S0; contains devkitA64, libnx, switch-tools and Switch portlibs including SDL2.
ci_toolchain.policy: Use the dated image tag for S0 CI. Record installed package/compiler versions on every run; do not silently substitute latest.
